name: email-finding
description: Find verified work email addresses for B2B contacts using multi-provider waterfall discovery. Use when the user wants to find emails, look up contact information, discover email patterns, enrich a list with email addresses, find decision-maker emails, or get verified contact data for outreach. Triggers on: \"find email\", \"get their email\", \"email discovery\", \"look up email\", \"find contact info\", \"email enrichment\", \"what's their email\", or any request to locate professional email addresses for prospects.
